name: new_v2_manus_external_rest_speed_matched_trial_analysis_v1
cells: Validation/final separately; pooled, each of six users, each of three native speeds and each of 18 user-by-speed cells; four arms paired on identical native recording IDs and gesture labels
conditional: Add F2a given F0v2+F3c and F3c given F0v2+F2a; positive delta_log_loss means lower held-out loss
scope: Post-hoc matched whole-trial analysis from a cross-dataset source-only Rest prior. Same users appear in Sessions 1/2/3; all speeds in each session; final session previously inspected. Speed strata are descriptive, not an unseen-speed intervention or own-device validation.
